sections.bio:
SEO & AI Search Consultant | I work with founders, C-Suite leaders, B2B companies, and pharmaceutical organizations that want to modernize their business with practical AI solutions.

I am the Founder and CEO of Reinforce Lab Ltd, where I help design and implement AI Growth Systems for businesses using AI automation, AI Search Optimization, SEO, and intelligent workflows.

My focus is on building systems that improve how businesses operate, market, sell, and grow.

Over the past 13+ years, I have worked across SEO, international business development, pharmaceutical marketing, and digital strategy. I combine that experience with modern AI to help organizations build smarter, faster, and more scalable businesses.

I specialize in building:

↳ AI Business Solutions 
↳ AI Automation Workflows
↳ AI Organic Growth Systems
↳ SEO and AI Search Optimization
↳ Executive Dashboards and Reporting
↳ AI-powered Content Solutions 
↳ Lead Generation Automation 
↳ Marketing and Sales Automation
↳ Knowledge Management Systems

My work helps organizations reduce repetitive work, improve decision making, increase search visibility, and create predictable growth.

Before founding Reinforce Lab, I worked in Product Management and International Business Development at JANSSEN Pharmaceutical Companies, Beacon Pharmaceuticals, and Square Group. That experience gave me a deep understanding of regulated industries, global markets, and commercial growth.

I combine that background with AI, automation, and modern search strategies to help businesses prepare for the future of search and work.

Industries I Work With
✓ E-commerce
✓ Pharmaceutical and Life Sciences
✓ B2B SaaS
✓ Manufacturing
✓ Technology Companies
✓ Growing Businesses 
✓ Professional Services

Recognition:
➥ SEMrush Ambassador 
➥ Top 50 eCommerce Online Sellers & Influencers by SaleHoo (2022 - 2026)
➥ Top 3 Business Intelligence Marketing Influencer by Onalytica 

I regularly share practical insights on:

↳ AI-first business workflows 
↳ SEO and AI Search 
↳ Enterprise content strategy
↳ Marketing automation
↳ Pharmaceutical digital growth
↳ Building scalable service businesses

I also share everything I build through my newsletter, AI Growth Systems for C-Suite.

Every issue includes practical AI solutions, automation workflows, search strategies, implementation guides, and real case studies that business leaders can apply inside their own organizations.

If your organization wants to build an AI-first growth engine that delivers long-term business value, let's connect.

posts.text:
Most companies are still treating AI like a tool.

The market data says that approach is already outdated.

Look at the numbers through 2035:

👉 Global AI market: 

✓ $235 billion in 2025.
✓ Projected to hit $1.77 trillion by 2035.

Total AI spending could reach $3 trillion by 2035.

👉 Generative AI:

✓ from $12 billion today 
✓ to $315 billion by 2035.

👉 Enterprise AI: 

✓ $30 billion now.
✓ $570 billion by 2035.

👉 AI Agents: 

✓ expected to grow past $180–220 billion in the same period.

👉 AI in marketing: 

✓ heading toward $80+ billion by 2030.
✓ Some forecasts see $145–300 billion by the early 2030s.

👉 Generative Engine Optimization (AI Search): 

✓ still small at around $1 billion.
✓ Projected to reach $7–33 billion by 2031–2036.

These are not small shifts.

Companies that only add AI tools will fall behind.

Companies that build real AI Growth Systems will capture the growth.

The window is open right now.

How are you preparing your business for this scale?

Sources: Emergen Research, Oxford Economics, MarketsandMarkets-style reports, specialized GEO analyses, and enterprise AI forecasts through 2035.
